2026.12.1-beta.1

Highlights

  • Updates: Git installations use prepared releases and a resident launcher, while package updates prepare without stopping the serving Gateway. (#203194, #203497) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Prompt caching: compaction reuses the warm prompt cache across routes, read-only prewarms keep idle caches warm, and automatic compaction starts at 85% of the context window. (#204111, #204219, #204210) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Templates: share an agent from its menu, preview a Template without expanding files into chat, and manage planned automations from chat cards. (#201644, #202060, #202126) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Session Share: pull authorized shared sessions over outbound WSS and open them in their source Control UI. (#201075, #203044) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Lean Gateways: share core worker code in one host and admit worker growth within a memory budget to reduce small-machine memory pressure. (#202495, #202507). Fixes #202377, #202376 Thanks @jalehman.
  • Skills: browse and search the ClawHub catalog by category, and open installed skills as full pages rather than dialogs. (#202756, #202581) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @vyctorbrzezowski.

Changes

  • Control UI: give Sessions its own rail destination and move Code Mode, Tool Search, and Templates out of Labs. (#201208, #203096) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @vincentkoc, @fuller-stack-dev, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Access management: administrators can share specific projects with restricted roles and assign profile roles from chat. (#203470, #202315). Fixes #202311 Thanks @jalehman.
  • Trusted-proxy authentication: add opt-in Cloudflare Access JWT verification instead of relying only on forwarded identity headers. (#200376). Fixes #200361 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Knowledge: let agents list Slack channels, choose the reading token, and learn from Slack through Knowledge. (#202410, #202411) Thanks @jalehman.
  • GBrain: connect through the plugin installer, including native installation without Bun on Apple Silicon Macs and x86-64 Linux. (#200625, #200987) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Model settings: choose harnesses for primary and fallback models, and control individual plugin tools from Settings. (#203358, #201453) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • OpenCode: sign in to OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go through the browser. (#202949) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Codex: target a branch, commit, or custom instructions with /codex review. (#202114) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Automations: back off when a provider pushes back, allow up to eight extra runs when memory permits, and name new jobs from their prompts. (#197395, #197394, #201184) Thanks @daniel-lxs and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Providers: add Nano Banana 2.1 image generation and route qualified Bedrock Converse streams through ClawRouter. (#200468, #192450) Thanks @markmcd, @obviyus, and @vincentkoc.
  • Slack: present streamed reasoning as task rows and continue long native streams in follow-up messages. (#143882) Thanks @n1hility and @sallyom.
  • Codex: update the bundled app-server and matching ACP runtime to 0.172.0, refresh protocol validation, and recognize externally managed GCP accounts during connector migration. Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Windows updates: replace migrated state databases, keep read-only database readers from breaking upgrades, and restart correctly after rollback. (#204094, #204095, #204224). Fixes #204085, #204078, #204196 Thanks @obviyus.
  • Update handoff: keep self-updates running through the first ready signal, run plugin maintenance after the replacement Gateway starts, and roll back stalled startups sooner. (#204215, #204127, #203990). Fixes #204035 Thanks @obviyus.
  • Git updates: prevent half-switched checkouts when older November 17 main updaters encounter a schema change. (#204275) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Doctor and plugins: finish updates with npm-installed official provider plugins or plugins that do not ship a Doctor artifact. (#204122, #204129). Fixes #203604 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @AS76.
  • Backups and reset: back up long-running installations with large session inventories, and leave state intact when a live Gateway refuses reset. (#203923, #202088). Fixes #203082, #202023 Thanks @vincentkoc, @sukhdeepjohar, @obviyus, @dygg2001, @etzelm, and @anmol0b.
  • Installation: keep openclaw available in new terminals after gateway install runs from npx. (#203943). Fixes #203942 Thanks @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
  • Chat history: preserve the reading position as old rows remeasure, keep earlier history reachable, and hold the top position when reading there. (#204153, #204216, #204220) Thanks @obviyus and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Unread indicators: advance only after a new visible reply, excluding hidden coordination and failed child activity. (#204281, #204143). Fixes #204164 Thanks @obviyus.
  • Subagents: settle undelivered child completions into parent history, preserve yield settlement through cleanup, and avoid duplicate final replies. (#204260, #204178, #203222, #204098) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
  • Claude CLI: preserve completed tool calls and inline widgets across chat reloads. (#203877, #204102) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @fonchaves, and @obviyus.
  • ACP: settle prompts that also deliver to channels and keep replies alive while tool results are still returning. (#202048, #202276). Fixes #202047 Thanks @ElanHasson, @obviyus, and @vsgik.
  • Codex sessions: prevent handoff stalls when a retired writer remains loaded. (#196172) Thanks @montrellcruse and @RomneyDa.
  • OpenAI: include the system prompt in uncached ChatGPT Responses input and keep account limits aligned while loading. (#202720, #204264). Fixes #202372 Thanks @Avi974, @RomneyDa, @migelizaga-rgb, and @jesse-merhi.
  • Model discovery: refresh cold catalogs during setup, report discovery failures in models status and Doctor, warn on small-context manual picks, and display provider plugin labels. (#202019, #194951, #200923, #204230). Fixes #202016 Thanks @etzelm, @VACInc, @daniel-lxs, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @sallyom, and @obviyus.
  • Teams and Feishu: deliver the remainder of rejected Teams stream endings without duplicating the reply, and honor Feishu card mode for non-streaming block replies. (#158429, #202368, #169681). Fixes #158103, #169550 Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @rdbartram, @obviyus, @Anurag-5ingh, and @name5566.
  • Discord and Telegram: use live voice-transcription configuration, refresh native commands after registry replacement, and preserve linked identity in private Telegram topics. (#202362, #199743, #198832). Fixes #199612 Thanks @obviyus, @555aaditya, @eliavb43, and @dankarization.
  • Quiet automations: preserve successful optional-silent collector runs, treat empty checklists as intentional skips, and avoid spurious failures after repeated result recording. (#164949, #202390, #202142). Fixes #164887, #203821, #202350, #202140 Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @Hensarj, @ArthurBook, @herosuncy, and @jalehman.
  • Automation delivery: notify script webhooks when restarts interrupt a run and route owner-targeted failure alerts to the owner rather than the last chat. (#204201, #189953). Fixes #204194, #189947 Thanks @daniel-lxs, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, and @obviyus.
  • Templates: allow adding without model sign-in, use the adding device’s time zone for automations, and start ready Templates during background refreshes. (#204234, #202175, #202960). Fixes #204207 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @daniel-lxs, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @vincentkoc.
  • PostgreSQL: let Gateways start with plugin-backed secrets and load Talk and plugins without worker-boundary failures. (#201976, #201063). Fixes #201969 Thanks @etzelm, @VACInc, and @Staruy.
  • Doctor recovery: retry heartbeat migration after a full-disk archive write instead of leaving it permanently stuck. (#201345). Fixes #200083 Thanks @anmol0b, @sallyom, and @wangmiao0668000666.
  • Credential and execution boundaries: apply credential limits to assistant media URLs, reject hidden shell-startup assignments in env commands, and bind realtime voice streams to signed calls. (#204154, #203934, #136506) Thanks @mmaps, @pgondhi987, and @drobison00.
  • Packaged Windows: preserve managed GitHub command execution. (#201712) Thanks @bkudiess and @RomneyDa.

title: openclaw 2026.10.34
summary:
This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of October 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is 2026.11.10

2026.10.34

This extended-stable patch updates the Gateway and official npm plugins from 2026.10.33. It includes the core npm package and Gateway Docker images, but no native-app releases.

Highlights

  • OpenAI and ClawRouter: select GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, with system-prompt caching on the OpenAI API-key and Sign in with ChatGPT Responses routes. (#200766, #201094) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, and @obviyus.
  • Tlon: group DMs use their own approval policy, and approved clubs remain authorized across Gateway restarts. (#202775) Thanks @joshavant.
  • Update recovery: avoid leaving the Gateway offline when an update runs alongside database readers or replaces a running checkout, and recover the service after a failed Windows update rolls back. (#201330, #202541, #203241, #203264) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Conversation continuity: deliver ready child results without waiting for other helpers to finish, and accept follow-up chat messages after the preceding run completes. (#203176, #203102, #201790) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Channel delivery: recover Telegram polling when update IDs reset, keep an undownloadable attachment from blocking replies, and reconnect all Discord accounts after a network outage. (#201167, #200682, #201415, #162189) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @mattreyes0824.

Changes

  • MiniMax: stop offering retired M2 models, including during live discovery, and use MiniMax-M3 for PDF text extraction. If your configuration explicitly selects an M2 model, switch it to a supported model. (#203998) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Access controls: apply the session permission mode consistently on Gateway tool calls, recheck bound Discord DMs against current policy, and keep Signal view-once attachments out of assistant context. (#202941, #196848, #196841) Thanks @obviyus and @drobison00.
  • Channel setup: save new tokens through the channel secret store rather than writing them to config as plaintext. (#201428, #175333) Thanks @anmol0b, @sallyom, and @masatohoshino.
  • Discord and Slack: queue independent Discord requests instead of replacing an active task, show when the target session is busy, and leave Slack question buttons available when a click comes from someone who cannot answer. (#201518, #201363, #201371, #201348) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @shannon0430.
  • Conversation delivery: return complete queued ACP replies, preserve Claude CLI final answers after progress messages, and avoid repeating tool work on a fallback model during long Claude CLI turns. (#202658, #200470, #200801, #200744) Thanks @obviyus, @chaeyn, @fede-kamel, and @jzmudzinski.
  • Conversation recovery: resume saved requests when transcript metadata advances, and keep pending child results when the requesting run ends or a follow-up takes over. (#201477, #195275) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
  • OpenAI and Codex: preserve session affinity for Sign in with ChatGPT and let Codex subagents start from agent folders with capital letters. (#197588, #197532, #201520, #201423) Thanks @sukhdeepjohar, @aatreya, @obviyus, and @thejeys19.
  • Provider reliability: compact before predicted context overflow instead of trimming tool results already cached by the provider, stop retrying Anthropic requests that require credits, and preserve user-configured model rows on provider sign-in. (#199530, #201997, #201742, #201558) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @LinzeShi, @MertBasar0, and @Caitoz.
  • Install and update: avoid hanging at NodeSource on Ubuntu 26.04, preserve pnpm-linked checkouts when switching to the npm release, and complete updates with read-only, unchanged config or old plugin leases. (#203538, #201701, #201331, #201314) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Storage and backups: let large PostgreSQL maintenance operations finish, recover after silent database connection loss, port upgraded stores to PostgreSQL, and reclaim space when backup staging databases are deleted. (#201869, #201856, #201299, #201250, #199666) Thanks @VACInc, @chelsealong, @evemorgen, and @etzelm.
  • Doctor: reuse the existing state database for offline update checks after backup, avoiding extra copies of large databases. (#202985) Authored by @steipete.
  • Browser and Control UI: capture background tabs in headed or headless Chrome, keep final answers out of the collapsed Worked fold, and preserve pending dictation transcripts while showing progress. (#202878, #165312, #201626, #197429, #200235) Thanks @obviyus, @titan550, @Marvinthebored, @vyctorbrzezowski, @Peetiegonzalez, and @daniel-lxs.
  • Automation and Feishu: deliver automation failure notices back to the chat that created the job and finish long replies in the same streaming card. (#203056, #161777, #139443) Thanks @obviyus, @ArthurNie, and @Simon2256928.
